title: AI Tools for Educators
overview: Discover how educators can leverage AI to enhance teaching, personalize learning, and save time. This program introduces practical AI tools designed specifically for classrooms, assignments, assessments, and content creation.
details: Use AI tools to automate administrative tasks and grading
Enhance lesson plans with AI-generated content and activities
Explore chatbots and virtual teaching assistants
Design interactive assessments and feedback tools using AI
Learn responsible and ethical AI use in education
modules: AI Tools for Lesson Planning and Content Creation
Ethical Use of AI in Schools

title: Conduct a Workshop
overview: Learn the complete framework to plan, organize, and conduct engaging technical or educational workshops. Perfect for educators, trainers, and professionals who want to share knowledge effectively.
details: Master the art of planning educational workshops from scratch
Learn how to design workshop content for impact and clarity
Use presentation tools and interactive techniques to engage learners
Handle live Q&A sessions, feedback, and session wrap-ups like a pro
Get templates, checklists, and best practices for any workshop
